newsitem.title: UK: OPEC ECB meets to prepare supply-demand report.
newsitem.headline: OPEC ECB meets to prepare supply-demand report.

text.p: OPEC's Economic Commission Board (ECB) of market and technical experts from all 11 members are meeting this week in Vienna to prepare a 1997 oil supply-demand outlook ahead of next week's ministerial conference.
OPEC sources said the meeting, which is expected to last all week, will get underway on Monday morning at the Secretariat headquarters.

The ECB report along with a market study prepared by the Secretariat will be used by ministers when they meet on November 27 in Vienna to set production levels for the cartel for the first half of 1997.
Despite surprisingly high oil prices, OPEC is not expected to tamper with its 25.03 million barrel per day ceiling, OPEC delegates and ministerial sources say.

Uncertainty over winter demand and the timing of the return of Iraqi oil exports under a delayed United Nations limited oil sale plan makes most OPEC members reluctant to raise the ceiling, sources say.
